info.title: Music Room API
info.description:
Backend of Music Room: Track Vote, Playlist Editor and Control Delegation.

Every app request must send `X-Platform`, `X-Device` and `X-App-Version`. Authenticate with **Authorize** using the `access_token` from `/auth/login`. Realtime updates: WebSocket `/ws` (protocol in the `realtime` section of the README).

post.description:
Always answers the same way, so this endpoint can't be used to test which
emails have an account. An existing user gets an email instead.
Log in with Google, or sign up if this Google account and its email are new.

post.description:
Idempotent: voting twice for the same track still counts once (enforced by
UNIQUE(event_id, track_id, user_id), so it also holds for simultaneous requests).

delete.description: The owner can remove any queued track; a user can remove their own suggestion.

post.description:
Owner's player: the current track is marked played and the top-voted one starts.

The event row is locked (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so two "next" at once can't both
pick the same track or skip one.
